scope: Prevent the concrete DXF adapter from reinterpreting an entity as modeler geometry, MESH, HELIX, or SPLINE solely because its mutable public eType contains a geometry tag.

behavior: A mismatched runtime object takes the adapter's fail-closed path before entering a type-specific writer.
A failed export preserves the prior destination.
Correcting the retained entity's eType permits a same-adapter retry and typed LINE readback.

validationProfile.source: Locally constructed DRW_Line records captured through dx_iface; each test mutates only the public eType. No DWG/DXF fixture is used or committed.
assertions: All twelve tag/encoding combinations are rejected when the runtime object is DRW_Line.
Every rejection preserves a pre-existing destination sentinel.
All corrected same-adapter retries import and preserve the authored line endpoints.
validationProfile.identityNote: The generated no-source LINE output receives a writer-assigned handle; the control checks runtime type and geometry rather than handle identity.

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1; twelve 3D tag/encoding refusal and retry cells plus LINE readback, in 0.73 seconds.
validation.fixturePolicy: No drawing fixture was added or committed.

limitations: The test uses a LINE with mutated eType as a controlled wrong-runtime-type input; it does not verify that valid native MESH/HELIX/modeler payloads round-trip.
It does not validate ACIS/SAB syntax, geometry, consumer semantics, ABI, or the full BLOCK callback inventory.
No support claim is promoted; P8 remains open.
